name: Kouno Harumi
source:
A highly energetic girl who appears out of nowhere and suddenly declares herself to be [url=/c15061]Takaaki[/url]'s lover, calling him "darling" and kissing him within moments of introducing herself to him. [spoiler]In reality she is Milfa (ミルファ), a robot with model designation HMX-17b, making her a "sister" of sorts to "[url=/c15124]HMX-17a Ilfa[/url]" and "[url=/c15134]HMX-17c Silfa[/url]". In the original game she borrows the body of a plush toy and is called Micchan in the Himeyuri sisters route.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_To_Heart_series_characters#To_Heart_2]Wikipedia[/url].]
